retrieval_metrics: nDCG@K when graded relevance is available
principle: Evaluate the evidence first, then the answer. Never treat a correct answer alone as proof of correct retrieval.
benchmark_integrity_checks: Every required_source_id must exist in the handbook or its normalized source/reference sections.
Date-specific questions must resolve using the policy active on the referenced date.
Campaign rules apply only during their active campaign period.
Regional rules must not silently conflict with temporal global versions; India policy defers to the active global version except for explicitly more specific India, campaign, or legal rules.
The same underlying source knowledge and evaluation questions must be used across representations and retrieval methods.
Evidence must preserve stable source_id values so retrieval results can be traced back to handbook content.
version_notes: V3 resolves temporal/regional ambiguity, replaces non-document synthetic IDs with handbook reference IDs, and makes Q034 a deterministic expired-campaign test.
